<section aria-label="Color and palette">
  <div class="palette-heading">
    <h2>
      "Color & palette"
    <span class="palette-count">
      "1 / 8 colors"
  <div aria-label="Palette colors" class="swatches" role="group">
    <button aria-label="Color 1: #00000000" aria-pressed="true" class="swatch">
      <span class="checker swatch-color">
        <span style="background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)">
      <span class="swatch-label">
        <span class="swatch-heading">
          <code>
            "#000000"
          <svg aria-hidden="true" class="selection-check" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5">
        <small>
          "0% opacity"
  <div class="palette-actions">
    <button>
      <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path d="M5 12h14 M12 5v14">
      "Add color"
    <button disabled="">
      " Remove selected "
  <div class="color-editor trigger-hidden">
    <div aria-label="Color picker" class="picker-panel" id="#1-picker" popover="" role="dialog">
      <div class="picker-heading">
        <strong>
          "Color"
        <button>
          "Close"
      <div class="color-surfaces">
        <div aria-label="Current color #00000000" class="checker current-color" role="img">
          <span style="background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)">
        <button aria-description="Saturation 0%, brightness 0%. Use left and right for saturation, up and down for brightness." aria-label="Saturation and brightness" class="sv-plane" style="background: linear-gradient(to top, rgb(0, 0, 0), transparent), linear-gradient(to right, rgb(255, 255, 255), transparent), rgb(255, 0, 0)">
          <span class="sv-marker" style="left: 0%; top: 100%">
        <div class="alpha-track checker" style="--color: #000000">
          <input :value="0" aria-label="Opacity" aria-orientation="vertical" class="alpha-slider" max="100" min="0" step="1" type="range" value="0">
      <input :value="0" aria-label="Hue" class="hue-slider" max="360" min="0" step="1" type="range" value="0">
      <details :open=false class="exact-values">
        <summary>
          "Exact values"
        <div class="exact-values-content">
          <div class="value-row">
            <label for="#1HSL">
              "HSL"
            <input :value="hsl(0, 0%, 0%)" aria-invalid="false" autocomplete="off" id="#1HSL" name="HSL" spellcheck="false" value="hsl(0, 0%, 0%)">
            <button aria-label="Copy HSL" class="copy-button">
              <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path d="M9 9h12v12H9z M5 15H3V3h12v2">
          <div class="value-row">
            <label for="#1RGBA">
              "RGBA"
            <input :value="rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)" aria-invalid="false" autocomplete="off" id="#1RGBA" name="RGBA" spellcheck="false" value="rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)">
            <button aria-label="Copy RGBA" class="copy-button">
              <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path d="M9 9h12v12H9z M5 15H3V3h12v2">
          <div class="value-row">
            <label for="#1HEX">
              "HEX"
            <input :value="#00000000" aria-invalid="false" autocomplete="off" id="#1HEX" name="HEX" spellcheck="false" value="#00000000">
            <button aria-label="Copy HEX" class="copy-button">
              <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path d="M9 9h12v12H9z M5 15H3V3h12v2">
